83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {

90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)

7: function hashString(str) {
8:   let h = 2166136261
9:   for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) }
10:   return h >>> 0
11: }

13: function rng(seed) {
14:   let a = seed >>> 0
15:   return () => {
16:     a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
17:     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
18:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
19:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
20:   }
21: }

23: function coatTexture(p, key) {
24:   const cacheKey = `${p.bodyColor}|${p.darkColor}|${p.accentColor}|${p.pattern.toFixed(2)}|${p.hide.toFixed(2)}|${key}`
25:   if (texCache.has(cacheKey)) return texCache.get(cacheKey)
26:   const size = 256
27:   const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
28:   canvas.width = canvas.height = size
29:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
30:   const r = rng(hashString(cacheKey))
31:   ctx.fillStyle = p.bodyColor
32:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size)
33: 
34:   // soft mottling
35:   for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
36:     const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 6 + r() * 26
37:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05 + r() * 0.1
38:     ctx.fillStyle = r() > 0.5 ? p.darkColor : p.accentColor
39:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rad, rad * (0.4 + r()), r() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
40:   }
41:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1
42: 
43:   const mode = Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.pattern * 4))
44:   ctx.fillStyle = p.darkColor
45:   if (mode === 0) {
46:     // High-contrast spots
47:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.48
48:     for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
49:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 3 + r() * 9
50:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rad * (0.7 + r() * 0.7), rad, r() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
51:     }
52:   } else if (mode === 1) {
53:     // Flowing bands
54:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42
55:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
56:       const y = i * 39 + 6 + r() * 10
57:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y)
58:       ctx.bezierCurveTo(70, y - 12, 170, y + 12, size, y - 4)
59:       ctx.lineTo(size, y + 12 + r() * 8)
60:       ctx.bezierCurveTo(170, y + 24, 70, y + 2, 0, y + 18)
61:       ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
62:     }
63:   } else if (mode === 2) {
64:     // Rosettes with a lighter center
65:     for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
66:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 5 + r() * 11
67:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.52
68:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
69:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.58
70:       ctx.fillStyle = p.accentColor
71:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, rad * 0.48, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
72:       ctx.fillStyle = p.darkColor
73:     }
74:   } else {
75:     // Fine dapple
76:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.34
77:     for (let i = 0; i < 96; i++) {
78:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 2 + r() * 7
79:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   // Skin-specific surface detail makes hide alleles apparent on the model.
84:   ctx.globalAlpha = p.hide < 0.25 ? 0.28 : 0.38
85:   if (p.hide < 0.25) {
86:     // Velvet/fur: short directional fibers
87:     ctx.strokeStyle = p.accentColor; ctx.lineWidth = 1
88:     for (let i = 0; i < 700; i++) {
89:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, len = 2 + r() * 5
90:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + len * 0.35, y + len); ctx.stroke()
91:     }
92:   } else if (p.hide < 0.5) {
93:     // Scaled hide: overlapping scale arcs
94:     ctx.strokeStyle = p.darkColor; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4
95:     for (let y = -8; y < size + 12; y += 12) for (let x = -8 + ((y / 12) % 2) * 7; x < size + 12; x += 14) {
96:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0.15, Math.PI - 0.15); ctx.stroke()
97:     }
98:   } else if (p.hide < 0.75) {
99:     // Plated hide: angular overlapping scutes
100:     ctx.fillStyle = p.accentColor; ctx.strokeStyle = p.darkColor; ctx.lineWidth = 2
101:     for (let y = 0; y < size; y += 32) for (let x = (y % 64 ? 0 : 16); x < size; x += 32) {
102:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.24 + r() * 0.16
103:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 13, y + 3); ctx.lineTo(x + 16, y + 17); ctx.lineTo(x + 8, y + 23); ctx.lineTo(x, y + 17); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
104:     }
105:   } else {
106:     // Crystal hide: bright crystalline facets
107:     ctx.fillStyle = p.accentColor
108:     for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
109:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 4 + r() * 13
110:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22 + r() * 0.3
111:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y - rad); ctx.lineTo(x + rad * 0.65, y + rad * 0.35); ctx.lineTo(x, y + rad); ctx.lineTo(x - rad * 0.65, y + rad * 0.35); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
112:     }
113:   }
114:   ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18
115:   for (let i = 0; i < 800; i++) {
116:     ctx.fillStyle = r() > 0.5 ? '#ffffff' : '#000000'
117:     ctx.fillRect(r() * size, r() * size, 1, 1)
118:   }
119:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1
120:   const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas)
121:   tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
122:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
123:   tex.anisotropy = 4
124:   texCache.set(cacheKey, tex)
125:   if (texCache.size > 100) {
126:     const first = texCache.keys().next().value
127:     texCache.get(first)?.dispose()
128:     texCache.delete(first)
129:   }
130:   return tex
131: }

133: function mat(color, opts = {}) {

135:     color,
136:     roughness: opts.roughness ?? 0.72,
137:     metalness: opts.metalness ?? 0.04,
138:     flatShading: opts.flat ?? false,
139:     emissive: opts.emissive ?? 0x000000,
140:     emissiveIntensity: opts.emissiveIntensity ?? 1,

142:     opacity: opts.opacity ?? 1,
143:     side: opts.side ?? THREE.FrontSide,
144:     ...(opts.map ? { map: opts.map } : {}),

148: function addMesh(parent, geo, material, pos = [0, 0, 0], rot = [0, 0, 0], scl = [1, 1, 1]) {
149:   const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material)
150:   m.position.set(...pos)
151:   m.rotation.set(...rot)
152:   m.scale.set(...scl)
153:   m.castShadow = true
154:   m.receiveShadow = true
155:   parent.add(m)
156:   return m

159: function addBone(parent, start, end, radius, material) {
160:   const a = new THREE.Vector3(...start), b = new THREE.Vector3(...end)
161:   const direction = b.clone().sub(a)
162:   const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius * 0.62, radius, direction.length(), 6), material)
163:   mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5)
164:   mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), direction.normalize())
165:   mesh.castShadow = true
166:   mesh.receiveShadow = true
167:   parent.add(mesh)
168:   return mesh
169: }

172: export function buildCreature(genome, opts = {}) {
173:   const p = phenotype(genome)
174:   const root = new THREE.Group()
175:   const model = new THREE.Group()

178:   const s = 0.78 + p.size * 0.52
179:   const species = Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))
180:   const bodyPlan = p.bodyPlanKey
181:   const fish = bodyPlan === 'fish'
182:   const insect = bodyPlan === 'insect'
183:   const bird = bodyPlan === 'bird'
184:   const biped = bodyPlan === 'biped'
185:   const quadruped = bodyPlan === 'quadruped'
186:   const upright = p.posture > 0.58
187:   const typeWidth = [1, 1.16, 0.78, 1.27][species]
188:   const typeLength = [1, 1.12, 0.86, 1.08][species]
189:   const planWidth = fish ? 0.9 : insect ? 1.08 : bird ? 0.82 : 1
190:   const planLength = fish ? 1.32 : insect ? 0.92 : bird ? 0.9 : 1
191:   const torsoRY = (0.5 + p.girth * 0.3) * s * [1, 0.98, 0.82, 1.2][species] * (fish ? 0.78 : 1)
192:   const torsoRX = (0.52 + p.girth * 0.48) * s * typeWidth * planWidth
193:   const torsoRZ = (0.62 + p.length * 0.55) * s * typeLength * planLength
194:   const legLen = fish ? 0 : (0.34 + p.legs * 0.62) * s * [1, 0.9, 1.22, 0.82][species] * (biped ? 1.04 : bird ? 0.82 : insect ? 0.55 : 1)
195:   const legThick = (0.09 + p.stance * 0.12) * [1, 0.9, 0.78, 1.42][species] * (insect ? 0.55 : bird ? 0.82 : 1)
196:   const hipY = legLen + torsoRY * 0.42
197:   const headScale = (0.34 + p.head * 0.36) * s * [1, 1.05, 0.88, 1.22][species] * (fish ? 0.9 : 1)
198:   const bodyY = fish ? torsoRY * 1.12 : legLen + torsoRY * (biped ? 0.62 : upright ? 0.58 : 0.52)
199:   const finLevel = fish ? Math.max(p.fins, 0.62) : p.fins
200:   const shellLevel = insect ? Math.max(p.carapace, 0.62) : p.carapace
201:   const antennaLevel = insect ? Math.max(p.antennae, 0.5) : p.antennae
202:   const wingLevel = bird ? Math.max(p.wings, 0.64) : p.wings
203:   const gillLevel = fish ? Math.max(p.gills, 0.56) : p.gills
204:   const tailLevel = fish ? Math.max(p.tail, 0.68) : p.tail
205:   const insectLegs = insect
206:     ? [-0.62, 0, 0.62].flatMap(z => [-1, 1].map(x => ({ x, z, front: z > 0, middle: z === 0 })))
207:     : null
208: 
209:   const coat = coatTexture(p, 'body')
210:   const bodyMat = mat(0xffffff, { map: coat, roughness: 0.66 })
211:   const darkMat = mat(p.darkColor, { roughness: 0.8 })
212:   const accentMat = mat(p.accentColor, { roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.12 })
213:   const boneMat = mat('#e8dfc4', { roughness: 0.62, flat: true })
214:   const clawMat = mat('#332f27', { roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.2 })
215:   const eyeMat = mat(p.eyeColor, { emissive: p.eyeColor, emissiveIntensity: 2.1, roughness: 0.2 })
216:   const pupilMat = mat('#0a0d0c', { roughness: 0.3 })
217:   const wingMat = mat(p.accentColor, { transparent: true, opacity: 0.72, side: THREE.DoubleSide, roughness: 0.5, emissive: p.darkColor, emissiveIntensity: 0.16 })

219:   const bodyGroup = new THREE.Group()
220:   bodyGroup.position.y = bodyY
221:   model.add(bodyGroup)

223:   const torsoGeo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2)

226:   // belly plate follows the body plan's torso angle.

229:   // ── neck & head ──

233:   const neckLen = (0.16 + p.neck * 0.62) * s * [1, 1.34, 1.08, 0.76][species]

236: 
237:   const headGroup = new THREE.Group()
238:   headGroup.position.set(0, neckLen * 0.82 + 0.06 * s, neckLen * 0.48)

249:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1), bodyMat,
250:       [0, -headScale * 0.12, headScale * 0.74 + snoutLen * 0.2], [0, 0, 0], [headScale * 0.44, headScale * 0.34, snoutLen * 0.62])

254:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(headScale * 0.41, snoutLen, 3, 8), darkMat,

256:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(headScale * 0.3, snoutLen * 0.68, 3, 8), bodyMat,
257:       [0, -headScale * 0.38, headScale * 0.7 + snoutLen * 0.24], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.6])
258:     if (!insect) {
259:       const toothGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.055, headScale * 0.19, 4)

261:         addMesh(headGroup, toothGeo, boneMat, [(i - 1.5) * headScale * 0.16, -headScale * 0.48, headScale * 0.72 + snoutLen * 0.4 + (i % 2) * 0.02], [Math.PI, 0, 0])

263:     }
264:   }
265:   // Eyes sit wide on aquatic and insect heads for distinct silhouettes.
266:   const eyeR = headScale * (0.13 + p.eyes * 0.1) * (insect ? 1.42 : 1)

268:     const ex = side * headScale * (insect || fish ? 0.76 : 0.58), ey = headScale * 0.16, ez = headScale * 0.62
269:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.SphereGeometry(eyeR, 14, 10), eyeMat, [ex, ey, ez], [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.7])
270:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.SphereGeometry(eyeR * 0.48, 10, 8), pupilMat, [ex + side * eyeR * 0.35, ey, ez + eyeR * 0.5], [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.5])
271:   }
272:   // brow ridge
273:   addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.BoxGeometry(headScale * 0.95, headScale * 0.16, headScale * 0.34), darkMat, [0, headScale * 0.36, headScale * 0.5], [0.18, 0, 0])

275:   // horns
276:   const hornPairs = p.horns > 0.74 ? 3 : p.horns > 0.46 ? 2 : p.horns > 0.16 ? 1 : 0

278:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
279:       const len = headScale * (0.55 + p.horns * 1.15) * (1 - pair * 0.22)

294:       addBone(headGroup, [side * headScale * 0.62, headScale * 0.95, 0], [side * headScale * 1.24, headScale * 1.2, headScale * 0.02], headScale * 0.07, boneMat)
295:       addBone(headGroup, [side * headScale * 1.24, headScale * 1.2, headScale * 0.02], [side * headScale * 1.35, headScale * 1.52, -headScale * 0.02], headScale * 0.055, boneMat)

297:   }
298:   if (antennaLevel > 0.24) {
299:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {

309:   // crest / ear fins

311:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {

316:   }

332:     const shellY = torsoRY * 0.34

334:       new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),

336:       [0, shellY, -torsoRZ * 0.02], [torsoTilt, 0, 0],
337:       [torsoRX * 0.94, torsoRY * (0.72 + p.carapace * 0.16), torsoRZ * 0.78])

343:       addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1), accentMat,

345:         [0, 0, side * 0.28], [torsoRX * 0.28, torsoRY * 0.36, torsoRZ * 0.62])

347:   }
348:   if (p.fins > 0.24) {

350:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
351:       const t = i / (count - 1)
352:       const z = torsoRZ * (0.72 - t * 1.48)
353:       const height = torsoRY * (0.32 + p.fins * 0.72) * (0.7 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.3)
354:       const width = torsoRZ * (0.12 + p.fins * 0.04)
355:       const finShape = new THREE.Shape()
356:       finShape.moveTo(-width * 0.5, 0)
357:       finShape.quadraticCurveTo(-width * 0.28, height * 0.72, width * 0.02, height)
358:       finShape.quadraticCurveTo(width * 0.12, height * 0.5, width * 0.5, 0)

362:       fin.material = wingMat

364:         [0, torsoRY * (0.78 - t * 0.08) + height * 0.78, z - width * 0.02], torsoRX * 0.025, accentMat)
365:     }
366:   }
367:   if (p.gills > 0.24) {
368:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
369:       const baseX = side * headScale * 0.68
370:       const baseY = -headScale * 0.08

139:   let sum = 0
140:   for (const gene of GENES) {

147: export function conditionOf(creature) {
148:   if (!creature) return 0
149:   const needs = creature.needs
150:   const vitality = averageNeeds(needs)
151:   const vigor = clamp01(heterozygosity(creature.genome) * 1.8) * 9
152:   const levelBonus = Math.min(6, (creature.wins || 0) * 0.8)
153:   const raw = vitality * 0.88 + vigor + levelBonus + 4
154:   return Math.round(clamp(raw, 4, 100))

164:     mobility: 8 + p.legs * 25 + p.speed * 32 + (1 - p.stance) * 12 + p.wings * 14 - p.size * 7,
165:     muscle: 6 + p.muscle * 88 + p.stance * 6,
166:     brain: 5 + p.brain * 88 + p.eyes * 7,
167:     condition: cond,
168:   }
169:   const out = {}
170:   for (const k of STAT_KEYS) out[k] = Math.round(clamp(k === 'condition' ? raw[k] : raw[k] * condMul, 3, 100))

260: // ─── breeding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
266:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
267:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
268:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
269:   }
270:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
271: }
272: 
273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }
294: 
295: const FIRST = ['Vex', 'Morrow', 'Thal', 'Kestrel', 'Nyra', 'Orin', 'Sable', 'Quill', 'Rime', 'Ash', 'Bramble', 'Cinder', 'Dusk', 'Echo', 'Fen', 'Gloam', 'Harrow', 'Iris', 'Juno', 'Kite', 'Lumen', 'Moss', 'Nettle', 'Onyx', 'Pyre', 'Rook', 'Silt', 'Thorn', 'Umber', 'Vale', 'Wisp', 'Yarrow', 'Zephyr', 'Cobalt', 'Dune', 'Ember', 'Flint', 'Gale', 'Hazel', 'Indigo', 'Jasper', 'Kelp', 'Lark', 'Mica', 'Nimbus', 'Opal', 'Pearl', 'Reed', 'Slate', 'Tide']
296: const SECOND = ['back', 'wing', 'maw', 'horn', 'crest', 'shade', 'spine', 'bloom', 'stride', 'gaze', 'fang', 'scale', 'song', 'tread', 'vault', 'whisper', 'cradle', 'howl', 'drift', 'spark']
297: 
298: export function makeName(genome, parents) {
299:   const p = phenotype(genome)
300:   const first = FIRST[Math.floor(Math.random() * FIRST.length)]
301:   let epithet = SECOND[Math.floor(Math.random() * SECOND.length)]
302:   if (p.horns > 0.65) epithet = 'horn'
303:   else if (p.wings > 0.6) epithet = 'wing'
304:   else if (p.brain > 0.7) epithet = 'gaze'
305:   else if (p.speed > 0.68) epithet = 'stride'
306:   else if (p.armor > 0.65) epithet = 'scale'
307:   const name = `${first}${epithet}`
308:   return name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1)
309: }
310: 
311: export function sexOf() {
312:   return Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'F' : 'M'
313: }
314: 
315: export function generateStarter(seed, bias) {
316:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, bias), seed)
317: }
318: 
319: export function generateWild(seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000)) {
320:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, { _wild: true }), seed)
321: }
322: 
323: function createCreature(genome, seed) {
324:   return {
325:     id: cryptoId(),
326:     name: makeName(genome),
327:     genome,
328:     sex: seed % 2 === 0 ? 'F' : 'M',
329:     needs: freshNeeds(86),
330:     wins: 0,
331:     battles: 0,
332:     born: Date.now(),
333:     generation: 0,
334:   }
335: }
336: 
337: let idCounter = 0
338: export function cryptoId() {
339:   idCounter++
340:   return 'c' + Date.now().toString(36) + idCounter.toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)
341: }
342: 
343: export function dnaSequence(genome) {
344:   const bases = 'ACGT'
345:   let seq = ''
346:   for (const gene of GENES) {
347:     const alleles = genome?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
348:     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
349:       const n = Math.floor(clamp(alleles[i] ?? 0.5) * 4095)
350:       for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) seq += bases[(n >> (j * 2)) & 3]
351:     }
352:     seq += '·'
353:   }
354:   return seq.slice(0, -1)
355: }
356: 
357: export function formatAge(born) {
358:   const s = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - born) / 1000)
359:   if (s < 90) return `${Math.floor(s)}s`
360:   if (s < 5400) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m`
361:   if (s < 86400 * 2) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h`
362:   return `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d`
363: }

261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]

273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }

83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {
89:       top: { value: new THREE.Color(top) },
90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
108: }

110: function sporeField(count, color, radius, height, size) {
111:   const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
112:   const seeds = []
113:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
114:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
115:     const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * radius
116:     const y = Math.random() * height
117:     positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
118:     positions[i * 3 + 1] = y
119:     positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
120:     seeds.push({ speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35, phase: Math.random() * 10, a })
121:   }
122:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
123:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
124:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color, size, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true })
125:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
126:   points.userData.seeds = seeds
127:   return points
128: }

122:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
123:   tex.anisotropy = 4
124:   texCache.set(cacheKey, tex)
125:   if (texCache.size > 100) {
126:     const first = texCache.keys().next().value
127:     texCache.get(first)?.dispose()
128:     texCache.delete(first)
129:   }
130:   return tex

133: function mat(color, opts = {}) {
134:   return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
135:     color,
136:     roughness: opts.roughness ?? 0.72,
137:     metalness: opts.metalness ?? 0.04,
138:     flatShading: opts.flat ?? false,
139:     emissive: opts.emissive ?? 0x000000,
140:     emissiveIntensity: opts.emissiveIntensity ?? 1,
141:     transparent: opts.transparent ?? false,
142:     opacity: opts.opacity ?? 1,
143:     side: opts.side ?? THREE.FrontSide,
144:     ...(opts.map ? { map: opts.map } : {}),
145:   })
146: }

148: function addMesh(parent, geo, material, pos = [0, 0, 0], rot = [0, 0, 0], scl = [1, 1, 1]) {
149:   const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material)
150:   m.position.set(...pos)
151:   m.rotation.set(...rot)
152:   m.scale.set(...scl)
153:   m.castShadow = true
154:   m.receiveShadow = true
155:   parent.add(m)
156:   return m
157: }

159: function addBone(parent, start, end, radius, material) {
160:   const a = new THREE.Vector3(...start), b = new THREE.Vector3(...end)
161:   const direction = b.clone().sub(a)
162:   const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius * 0.62, radius, direction.length(), 6), material)
163:   mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5)
164:   mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), direction.normalize())
165:   mesh.castShadow = true
166:   mesh.receiveShadow = true
167:   parent.add(mesh)
168:   return mesh
169: }

209:   const coat = coatTexture(p, 'body')

295:       addBone(headGroup, [side * headScale * 1.24, headScale * 1.2, headScale * 0.02], [side * headScale * 1.35, headScale * 1.52, -headScale * 0.02], headScale * 0.055, boneMat)

55: export function mulberry32(seed) {
56:   let a = seed >>> 0
57:   return function () {
58:     a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
59:     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
60:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t

68: export function randomGenome(seed, bias = {}) {
69:   const r = seed == null ? Math.random : mulberry32(seed)
70:   const genome = {}
71:   for (const gene of GENES) {
72:     const b = bias[gene.key] ?? 0.5
73:     const spread = bias[gene.key + '_spread'] ?? 0.34
74:     const center = clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * spread, 0.06, 0.96)
75:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
76:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
77:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
78:     if (bias._wild) {
79:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
80:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
82:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
83:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
84:         : [r(), r()]

261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
266:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
267:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
268:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
269:   }
270:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
271: }

273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }

83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {
89:       top: { value: new THREE.Color(top) },
90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
108: }

110: function sporeField(count, color, radius, height, size) {
111:   const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
112:   const seeds = []
113:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
114:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
115:     const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * radius
116:     const y = Math.random() * height
117:     positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
118:     positions[i * 3 + 1] = y
119:     positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
120:     seeds.push({ speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35, phase: Math.random() * 10, a })
121:   }
122:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
123:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
124:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color, size, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true })
125:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
126:   points.userData.seeds = seeds
127:   return points
128: }

78:     if (bias._wild) {

261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
266:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
267:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2

271: }

273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }

83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {
89:       top: { value: new THREE.Color(top) },
90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
108: }

110: function sporeField(count, color, radius, height, size) {
111:   const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
112:   const seeds = []
113:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
114:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
115:     const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * radius
116:     const y = Math.random() * height
117:     positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
118:     positions[i * 3 + 1] = y
119:     positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
120:     seeds.push({ speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35, phase: Math.random() * 10, a })
121:   }
122:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
123:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
124:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color, size, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true })
125:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
126:   points.userData.seeds = seeds
127:   return points
128: }

50: const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
51: export const clamp01 = v => clamp(v)
52: export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t
53: export const mix = (a, b, t) => Math.round(a + (b - a) * t)

55: export function mulberry32(seed) {
56:   let a = seed >>> 0
57:   return function () {
58:     a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
59:     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
60:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
61:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
62:   }
63: }

65: const rnd = (min, max) => min + Math.random() * (max - min)

67: // ─── genome creation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
68: export function randomGenome(seed, bias = {}) {
69:   const r = seed == null ? Math.random : mulberry32(seed)
70:   const genome = {}
71:   for (const gene of GENES) {
72:     const b = bias[gene.key] ?? 0.5
73:     const spread = bias[gene.key + '_spread'] ?? 0.34
74:     const center = clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * spread, 0.06, 0.96)
75:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
76:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
77:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
78:     if (bias._wild) {
79:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
80:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
82:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
83:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
84:         : [r(), r()]
85:     } else {
86:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]
87:     }
88:   }
89:   return genome
90: }
91: 
92: // Phenotype: average expression; a few genes skew dominant to create variety.
93: export function phenotype(genome) {
94:   const p = {}
95:   for (const gene of GENES) {
96:     // Older local saves predate newer appearance genes; keep them playable.
97:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome[gene.key] || []
98:     p[gene.key] = (a + b) / 2
99:   }
100:   // Derived composite values used by the mesh builder.
101:   const size = p.size
102:   p.height = 0.72 + size * 0.62 + p.legs * 0.18
103:   p.huePrimary = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueA))
104:   p.hueAccent = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueB))
105:   p.sat = Math.round(38 + p.pattern * 34 + p.muscle * 10)
106:   p.lightness = Math.round(52 - p.bone * 12 + p.eyes * 4)
107:   p.bodyColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary} ${p.sat}% ${p.lightness}%)`
108:   p.accentColor = `hsl(${p.hueAccent} ${Math.min(92, p.sat + 18)}% ${58 + p.eyes * 8}%)`
109:   p.darkColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary - 12} ${p.sat + 6}% ${Math.max(18, p.lightness - 26)}%)`
110:   p.eyeColor = `hsl(${(p.hueAccent + 38) % 360} 100% ${62 + p.brain * 10}%)`
111:   p.speciesType = ['Drake', 'Mireling', 'Skykin', 'Goliath'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))]
112:   p.skinType = ['Velvet hide', 'Scaled hide', 'Plated hide', 'Crystal hide'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.hide * 4))]
113:   p.postureName = p.posture > 0.58 ? 'Upright' : 'Grounded'
114:   const bodyPlanIndex = Math.min(BODY_PLANS.length - 1, Math.floor(p.bodyPlan * BODY_PLANS.length))
115:   p.bodyPlanKey = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].key
116:   p.bodyPlanName = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].label
117:   p.skinRoughness = 0.9 - p.hide * 0.62
118:   p.horniness = p.horns
119:   p.limbCount = { fish: 0, insect: 6, bird: 2, quadruped: 4, biped: 2 }[p.bodyPlanKey]
120:   return p
121: }

134: export function averageNeeds(needs) {
135:   return (needs.hunger + needs.energy + needs.hygiene + needs.fun) / 4

138: export function heterozygosity(genome) {
139:   let sum = 0
140:   for (const gene of GENES) {
141:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome?.[gene.key] || []
142:     sum += Math.abs(a - b)
143:   }
144:   return sum / GENES.length

147: export function conditionOf(creature) {
148:   if (!creature) return 0
149:   const needs = creature.needs
150:   const vitality = averageNeeds(needs)
151:   const vigor = clamp01(heterozygosity(creature.genome) * 1.8) * 9
152:   const levelBonus = Math.min(6, (creature.wins || 0) * 0.8)
153:   const raw = vitality * 0.88 + vigor + levelBonus + 4
154:   return Math.round(clamp(raw, 4, 100))
155: }

157: export function statsOf(creature) {
158:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
159:   const cond = conditionOf(creature)
160:   const condMul = 0.72 + (cond / 100) * 0.28
161:   const raw = {
162:     power: 12 + p.size * 18 + p.muscle * 30 + p.bone * 14 + p.horns * 12 + p.snout * 6 + p.armor * 7,
163:     bones: 8 + p.bone * 84 + p.armor * 8,
164:     mobility: 8 + p.legs * 25 + p.speed * 32 + (1 - p.stance) * 12 + p.wings * 14 - p.size * 7,
165:     muscle: 6 + p.muscle * 88 + p.stance * 6,
166:     brain: 5 + p.brain * 88 + p.eyes * 7,
167:     condition: cond,
168:   }
169:   const out = {}
170:   for (const k of STAT_KEYS) out[k] = Math.round(clamp(k === 'condition' ? raw[k] : raw[k] * condMul, 3, 100))
171:   return out
172: }

177:   return Math.round(64 + p.size * 58 + p.bone * 34 + stats.muscle * 0.28 + p.armor * 16 + (creature.wins || 0) * 3)

219:     power: 1.08 + p.horns * 0.52 + p.bone * 0.25,

221:     desc: 'Lower the crown and charge. Huge damage, less accurate.',

224:   if (p.armor > 0.2 || p.size > 0.55) moves.push({

243:     fx: 'gust', buff: 'evade',

258: }

260: // ─── breeding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
266:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
267:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
268:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
269:   }
270:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
271: }
272: 
273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }

295: const FIRST = ['Vex', 'Morrow', 'Thal', 'Kestrel', 'Nyra', 'Orin', 'Sable', 'Quill', 'Rime', 'Ash', 'Bramble', 'Cinder', 'Dusk', 'Echo', 'Fen', 'Gloam', 'Harrow', 'Iris', 'Juno', 'Kite', 'Lumen', 'Moss', 'Nettle', 'Onyx', 'Pyre', 'Rook', 'Silt', 'Thorn', 'Umber', 'Vale', 'Wisp', 'Yarrow', 'Zephyr', 'Cobalt', 'Dune', 'Ember', 'Flint', 'Gale', 'Hazel', 'Indigo', 'Jasper', 'Kelp', 'Lark', 'Mica', 'Nimbus', 'Opal', 'Pearl', 'Reed', 'Slate', 'Tide']
296: const SECOND = ['back', 'wing', 'maw', 'horn', 'crest', 'shade', 'spine', 'bloom', 'stride', 'gaze', 'fang', 'scale', 'song', 'tread', 'vault', 'whisper', 'cradle', 'howl', 'drift', 'spark']
297: 
298: export function makeName(genome, parents) {
299:   const p = phenotype(genome)
300:   const first = FIRST[Math.floor(Math.random() * FIRST.length)]
301:   let epithet = SECOND[Math.floor(Math.random() * SECOND.length)]
302:   if (p.horns > 0.65) epithet = 'horn'
303:   else if (p.wings > 0.6) epithet = 'wing'
304:   else if (p.brain > 0.7) epithet = 'gaze'
305:   else if (p.speed > 0.68) epithet = 'stride'
306:   else if (p.armor > 0.65) epithet = 'scale'
307:   const name = `${first}${epithet}`
308:   return name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1)
309: }
310: 
311: export function sexOf() {
312:   return Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'F' : 'M'
313: }
314: 
315: export function generateStarter(seed, bias) {
316:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, bias), seed)
317: }
318: 
319: export function generateWild(seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000)) {
320:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, { _wild: true }), seed)
321: }
322: 
323: function createCreature(genome, seed) {
324:   return {
325:     id: cryptoId(),
326:     name: makeName(genome),
327:     genome,
328:     sex: seed % 2 === 0 ? 'F' : 'M',
329:     needs: freshNeeds(86),
330:     wins: 0,
331:     battles: 0,
332:     born: Date.now(),
333:     generation: 0,
334:   }
335: }
336: 
337: let idCounter = 0
338: export function cryptoId() {
339:   idCounter++
340:   return 'c' + Date.now().toString(36) + idCounter.toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)
341: }
342: 
343: export function dnaSequence(genome) {
344:   const bases = 'ACGT'
345:   let seq = ''
346:   for (const gene of GENES) {
347:     const alleles = genome?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
348:     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
349:       const n = Math.floor(clamp(alleles[i] ?? 0.5) * 4095)
350:       for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) seq += bases[(n >> (j * 2)) & 3]
351:     }
352:     seq += '·'
353:   }
354:   return seq.slice(0, -1)
355: }
356: 
357: export function formatAge(born) {
358:   const s = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - born) / 1000)
359:   if (s < 90) return `${Math.floor(s)}s`
360:   if (s < 5400) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m`
361:   if (s < 86400 * 2) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h`
362:   return `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d`
363: }

83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {
89:       top: { value: new THREE.Color(top) },
90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
108: }

110: function sporeField(count, color, radius, height, size) {
111:   const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
112:   const seeds = []
113:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
114:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
115:     const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * radius
116:     const y = Math.random() * height
117:     positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
118:     positions[i * 3 + 1] = y
119:     positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
120:     seeds.push({ speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35, phase: Math.random() * 10, a })
121:   }
122:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
123:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
124:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color, size, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true })
125:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
126:   points.userData.seeds = seeds
127:   return points
128: }

261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
266:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
267:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
268:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
269:   }
270:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
271: }

273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }

581:   battleLunge(who, cb) {
582:     if (!this.fighters) return
583:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
584:     const start = who === 'player' ? this.playerStart : this.foeStart
585:     const dir = who === 'player' ? 1.6 : -1.6
586:     const t0 = performance.now()
587:     const dur = 320
588:     const tick = () => {
589:       const k = (performance.now() - t0) / dur
590:       if (k >= 1) { mesh.position.x = start.x; if (cb) cb(); return }
591:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI)
592:       mesh.position.x = start.x + dir * e
593:       mesh.position.z = start.z - (who === 'player' ? 0.8 : 0.8) * e
594:       requestAnimationFrame(tick)
595:     }
596:     tick()
597:   }

606:     const tick = () => {

608:       const k = (performance.now() - t0) / 300
609:       if (k >= 1) { mesh.position.copy(start); done?.(); return }
610:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI) * 0.24
611:       mesh.position.x = start.x + (who === 'player' ? -e : e)
612:       requestAnimationFrame(tick)
613:     }
614:     tick()
615:     this.burst({ x: mesh.position.x, y: 1.05, z: mesh.position.z }, who === 'player' ? '#ff7a6b' : '#ffd27a', 26)
616:   }

618:   faint(who) {

621:     const start = { x: mesh.position.x, y: mesh.position.y, z: mesh.position.z, rotation: mesh.rotation.z }
622:     const direction = who === 'player' ? 1 : -1
623:     const t0 = performance.now()

627:       const ease = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3

629:       mesh.position.x = start.x + direction * ease * 0.18

654:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

676:   bindPointer() {
677:     const el = this.renderer.domElement
678:     const down = e => {
679:       this.pointer.down = true
680:       this.pointer.moved = 0
681:       this.pointer.x = e.clientX
682:       this.pointer.y = e.clientY
683:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
684:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
685:       this.autoRotate = false
686:       el.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
687:     }
688:     const move = e => {
689:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
690:       const dx = e.clientX - this.pointer.lx
691:       const dy = e.clientY - this.pointer.ly
692:       this.pointer.moved += Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy)
693:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
694:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
695:       this.orbit.yaw -= dx * 0.006
696:       this.orbit.pitch = clamp(this.orbit.pitch + dy * 0.004, 0.02, 0.95)
697:     }
698:     const up = e => {
699:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
700:       this.pointer.down = false
701:       if (this.pointer.moved < 8) this.pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY)
702:       if (this.mode === 'habitat') this.autoRotate = true
703:     }
704:     el.addEventListener('pointerdown', down)
705:     el.addEventListener('pointermove', move)
706:     el.addEventListener('pointerup', up)
707:     el.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { this.pointer.down = false })
708:     el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
709:       e.preventDefault()
710:       this.orbit.radius = clamp(this.orbit.radius + e.deltaY * 0.006, 6.5, 15)
711:     }, { passive: false })
712:   }
713: 
714:   pickAt(clientX, clientY) {
715:     if (this.mode !== 'habitat') return
716:     const rect = this.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect()
717:     this.ndc.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1
718:     this.ndc.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
719:     this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this.ndc, this.camera)
720:     const hits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.habitat.children, true)
721:     for (const hit of hits) {
722:       let o = hit.object
723:       while (o && !o.userData.creatureId) o = o.parent
724:       if (o?.userData.creatureId) {
725:         this.hooks.onSelect?.(o.userData.creatureId)
726:         return
727:       }
728:     }
729:     this.hooks.onBackground?.()
730:   }

740:   loop() {
741:     this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop())
742:     const dt = Math.min(0.05, this.clock.getDelta())
743:     this.time += dt
744: 
745:     if (this.mode === 'habitat') {
746:       this.updateHabitat(dt)
747:     } else {
748:       this.updateArena(dt)
749:     }
750: 
751:     this.updateParticles(dt)
752: 
753:     const orbit = this.orbit
754:     if (this.autoRotate && this.mode === 'habitat') {
755:       this.orbitYaw = (this.orbitYaw ?? orbit.yaw) + dt * 0.028
756:       orbit.yaw = this.orbitYaw
757:     }
758:     const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, orbit.targetY, 0)
759:     const dist = orbit.radius
760:     const camX = Math.sin(orbit.yaw) * Math.cos(orbit.pitch) * dist
761:     const camZ = Math.cos(orbit.yaw) * Math.cos(orbit.pitch) * dist
762:     const camY = orbit.targetY + Math.sin(orbit.pitch) * dist + 0.4
763:     this.camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(camX, camY, camZ), 0.08)
764:     if (this.shakeAmt > 0.001) {
765:       this.camera.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shakeAmt
766:       this.camera.position.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shakeAmt
767:       this.shakeAmt *= 0.9
768:     }
769:     this.camera.lookAt(target)
770: 
771:     // slow toggling details
772:     if (this.isles) for (const isle of this.isles) {
773:       isle.position.y = isle.userData.baseY + Math.sin(this.time * 0.5 + isle.userData.phase) * 0.25
774:       isle.rotation.y += dt * 0.05
775:     }
776:     if (this.arena.visible && this.arenaBeams) this.arenaBeams.rotation.y += dt * 0.03
777:     if (this.p1Ring) {
778:       const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(this.time * 2.4) * 0.07
779:       this.p1Ring.scale.setScalar(pulse)
780:       this.p2Ring.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.sin(this.time * 2.4 + 1.6) * 0.07)
781:     }
782: 
783:     this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera)
784:   }

786:   updateHabitat(dt) {
787:     const list = [...this.creatures.values()]
788:     for (const entry of list) {
789:       if (!this.habitat.children.includes(entry.root)) continue
790:       entry.pause -= dt
791:       const dx = entry.target.x - entry.root.position.x
792:       const dz = entry.target.z - entry.root.position.z
793:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz)

81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {

83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {
89:       top: { value: new THREE.Color(top) },
90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
108: }

110: function sporeField(count, color, radius, height, size) {

114:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
115:     const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * radius
116:     const y = Math.random() * height
117:     positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
118:     positions[i * 3 + 1] = y
119:     positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
120:     seeds.push({ speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35, phase: Math.random() * 10, a })
121:   }
122:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
123:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
124:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color, size, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true })
125:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
126:   points.userData.seeds = seeds
127:   return points
128: }

78:     if (bias._wild) {

273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}

280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]

71:   for (const gene of GENES) {

75:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)

78:     if (bias._wild) {
79:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
80:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
82:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null

68: export function randomGenome(seed, bias = {}) {
69:   const r = seed == null ? Math.random : mulberry32(seed)
70:   const genome = {}
71:   for (const gene of GENES) {
72:     const b = bias[gene.key] ?? 0.5
73:     const spread = bias[gene.key + '_spread'] ?? 0.34
74:     const center = clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * spread, 0.06, 0.96)
75:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
76:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
77:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
78:     if (bias._wild) {
79:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
80:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
82:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
83:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
84:         : [r(), r()]
85:     } else {
86:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]
87:     }
88:   }
89:   return genome
90: }

50: const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
51: export const clamp01 = v => clamp(v)
52: export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t
53: export const mix = (a, b, t) => Math.round(a + (b - a) * t)

55: export function mulberry32(seed) {
56:   let a = seed >>> 0
57:   return function () {
58:     a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
59:     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
60:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
61:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
62:   }
63: }

65: const rnd = (min, max) => min + Math.random() * (max - min)

67: // ─── genome creation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
68: export function randomGenome(seed, bias = {}) {
69:   const r = seed == null ? Math.random : mulberry32(seed)
70:   const genome = {}
71:   for (const gene of GENES) {
72:     const b = bias[gene.key] ?? 0.5
73:     const spread = bias[gene.key + '_spread'] ?? 0.34
74:     const center = clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * spread, 0.06, 0.96)
75:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
76:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
77:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
78:     if (bias._wild) {
79:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
80:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
82:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
83:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
84:         : [r(), r()]
85:     } else {
86:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]
87:     }
88:   }
89:   return genome
90: }
91: 
92: // Phenotype: average expression; a few genes skew dominant to create variety.
93: export function phenotype(genome) {
94:   const p = {}
95:   for (const gene of GENES) {
96:     // Older local saves predate newer appearance genes; keep them playable.
97:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome[gene.key] || []
98:     p[gene.key] = (a + b) / 2
99:   }
100:   // Derived composite values used by the mesh builder.
101:   const size = p.size
102:   p.height = 0.72 + size * 0.62 + p.legs * 0.18
103:   p.huePrimary = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueA))
104:   p.hueAccent = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueB))
105:   p.sat = Math.round(38 + p.pattern * 34 + p.muscle * 10)
106:   p.lightness = Math.round(52 - p.bone * 12 + p.eyes * 4)
107:   p.bodyColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary} ${p.sat}% ${p.lightness}%)`
108:   p.accentColor = `hsl(${p.hueAccent} ${Math.min(92, p.sat + 18)}% ${58 + p.eyes * 8}%)`
109:   p.darkColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary - 12} ${p.sat + 6}% ${Math.max(18, p.lightness - 26)}%)`
110:   p.eyeColor = `hsl(${(p.hueAccent + 38) % 360} 100% ${62 + p.brain * 10}%)`
111:   p.speciesType = ['Drake', 'Mireling', 'Skykin', 'Goliath'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))]
112:   p.skinType = ['Velvet hide', 'Scaled hide', 'Plated hide', 'Crystal hide'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.hide * 4))]
113:   p.postureName = p.posture > 0.58 ? 'Upright' : 'Grounded'
114:   const bodyPlanIndex = Math.min(BODY_PLANS.length - 1, Math.floor(p.bodyPlan * BODY_PLANS.length))
115:   p.bodyPlanKey = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].key
116:   p.bodyPlanName = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].label
117:   p.skinRoughness = 0.9 - p.hide * 0.62
118:   p.horniness = p.horns
119:   p.limbCount = { fish: 0, insect: 6, bird: 2, quadruped: 4, biped: 2 }[p.bodyPlanKey]
120:   return p
121: }

123: // ─── stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
124: export const STAT_KEYS = ['power', 'bones', 'mobility', 'muscle', 'brain', 'condition']
125: export const STAT_META = {
126:   power:    { label: 'Ability',  color: '#d8ff5f', short: 'PWR' },
127:   bones:    { label: 'Bones',    color: '#ffd36e', short: 'BON' },
128:   mobility: { label: 'Mobility', color: '#67e8f9', short: 'MOB' },

130:   brain:    { label: 'Brain',    color: '#c4a7ff', short: 'BRN' },

134: export function averageNeeds(needs) {
135:   return (needs.hunger + needs.energy + needs.hygiene + needs.fun) / 4

138: export function heterozygosity(genome) {
139:   let sum = 0
140:   for (const gene of GENES) {
141:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome?.[gene.key] || []
142:     sum += Math.abs(a - b)
143:   }
144:   return sum / GENES.length

147: export function conditionOf(creature) {
148:   if (!creature) return 0
149:   const needs = creature.needs
150:   const vitality = averageNeeds(needs)
151:   const vigor = clamp01(heterozygosity(creature.genome) * 1.8) * 9
152:   const levelBonus = Math.min(6, (creature.wins || 0) * 0.8)
153:   const raw = vitality * 0.88 + vigor + levelBonus + 4
154:   return Math.round(clamp(raw, 4, 100))
155: }

157: export function statsOf(creature) {
158:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
159:   const cond = conditionOf(creature)
160:   const condMul = 0.72 + (cond / 100) * 0.28
161:   const raw = {
162:     power: 12 + p.size * 18 + p.muscle * 30 + p.bone * 14 + p.horns * 12 + p.snout * 6 + p.armor * 7,
163:     bones: 8 + p.bone * 84 + p.armor * 8,
164:     mobility: 8 + p.legs * 25 + p.speed * 32 + (1 - p.stance) * 12 + p.wings * 14 - p.size * 7,
165:     muscle: 6 + p.muscle * 88 + p.stance * 6,
166:     brain: 5 + p.brain * 88 + p.eyes * 7,
167:     condition: cond,
168:   }
169:   const out = {}
170:   for (const k of STAT_KEYS) out[k] = Math.round(clamp(k === 'condition' ? raw[k] : raw[k] * condMul, 3, 100))
171:   return out
172: }

175:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)

177:   return Math.round(64 + p.size * 58 + p.bone * 34 + stats.muscle * 0.28 + p.armor * 16 + (creature.wins || 0) * 3)

219:     power: 1.08 + p.horns * 0.52 + p.bone * 0.25,
220:     acc: 0.76 + p.speed * 0.15 + p.eyes * 0.06, tag: 'HORN',
221:     desc: 'Lower the crown and charge. Huge damage, less accurate.',
222:     fx: 'gore', crit: 0.1 + p.horns * 0.14,

224:   if (p.armor > 0.2 || p.size > 0.55) moves.push({

260: // ─── breeding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
266:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
267:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
268:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
269:   }
270:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
271: }
272: 
273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }

295: const FIRST = ['Vex', 'Morrow', 'Thal', 'Kestrel', 'Nyra', 'Orin', 'Sable', 'Quill', 'Rime', 'Ash', 'Bramble', 'Cinder', 'Dusk', 'Echo', 'Fen', 'Gloam', 'Harrow', 'Iris', 'Juno', 'Kite', 'Lumen', 'Moss', 'Nettle', 'Onyx', 'Pyre', 'Rook', 'Silt', 'Thorn', 'Umber', 'Vale', 'Wisp', 'Yarrow', 'Zephyr', 'Cobalt', 'Dune', 'Ember', 'Flint', 'Gale', 'Hazel', 'Indigo', 'Jasper', 'Kelp', 'Lark', 'Mica', 'Nimbus', 'Opal', 'Pearl', 'Reed', 'Slate', 'Tide']
296: const SECOND = ['back', 'wing', 'maw', 'horn', 'crest', 'shade', 'spine', 'bloom', 'stride', 'gaze', 'fang', 'scale', 'song', 'tread', 'vault', 'whisper', 'cradle', 'howl', 'drift', 'spark']
297: 
298: export function makeName(genome, parents) {
299:   const p = phenotype(genome)
300:   const first = FIRST[Math.floor(Math.random() * FIRST.length)]
301:   let epithet = SECOND[Math.floor(Math.random() * SECOND.length)]
302:   if (p.horns > 0.65) epithet = 'horn'
303:   else if (p.wings > 0.6) epithet = 'wing'
304:   else if (p.brain > 0.7) epithet = 'gaze'
305:   else if (p.speed > 0.68) epithet = 'stride'
306:   else if (p.armor > 0.65) epithet = 'scale'
307:   const name = `${first}${epithet}`
308:   return name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1)
309: }
310: 
311: export function sexOf() {
312:   return Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'F' : 'M'
313: }
314: 
315: export function generateStarter(seed, bias) {
316:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, bias), seed)
317: }
318: 
319: export function generateWild(seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000)) {
320:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, { _wild: true }), seed)
321: }
322: 
323: function createCreature(genome, seed) {
324:   return {
325:     id: cryptoId(),
326:     name: makeName(genome),
327:     genome,
328:     sex: seed % 2 === 0 ? 'F' : 'M',
329:     needs: freshNeeds(86),
330:     wins: 0,
331:     battles: 0,
332:     born: Date.now(),
333:     generation: 0,
334:   }
335: }
336: 
337: let idCounter = 0
338: export function cryptoId() {
339:   idCounter++
340:   return 'c' + Date.now().toString(36) + idCounter.toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)
341: }
342: 
343: export function dnaSequence(genome) {
344:   const bases = 'ACGT'
345:   let seq = ''
346:   for (const gene of GENES) {
347:     const alleles = genome?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
348:     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
349:       const n = Math.floor(clamp(alleles[i] ?? 0.5) * 4095)
350:       for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) seq += bases[(n >> (j * 2)) & 3]
351:     }
352:     seq += '·'
353:   }
354:   return seq.slice(0, -1)
355: }
356: 
357: export function formatAge(born) {
358:   const s = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - born) / 1000)
359:   if (s < 90) return `${Math.floor(s)}s`
360:   if (s < 5400) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m`
361:   if (s < 86400 * 2) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h`
362:   return `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d`
363: }

78:     if (bias._wild) {

55: export function mulberry32(seed) {

78:     if (bias._wild) {

80:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {

650:       this.burstState = { next: 0, max, life: new Float32Array(max), vel: new Float32Array(max * 3), color: new Float32Array(max * 3) }

653:     const c = new THREE.Color(color)
654:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
655:       const idx = st.next
656:       st.next = (st.next + 1) % st.max

667:     }

669:     this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true
670:   }

672:   shake(amount) {
673:     this.shakeAmt = Math.min(0.5, this.shakeAmt + amount)
674:   }

676:   bindPointer() {
677:     const el = this.renderer.domElement
678:     const down = e => {
679:       this.pointer.down = true
680:       this.pointer.moved = 0
681:       this.pointer.x = e.clientX
682:       this.pointer.y = e.clientY
683:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
684:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
685:       this.autoRotate = false
686:       el.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
687:     }
688:     const move = e => {
689:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
690:       const dx = e.clientX - this.pointer.lx
691:       const dy = e.clientY - this.pointer.ly
692:       this.pointer.moved += Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy)
693:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
694:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
695:       this.orbit.yaw -= dx * 0.006
696:       this.orbit.pitch = clamp(this.orbit.pitch + dy * 0.004, 0.02, 0.95)
697:     }
698:     const up = e => {
699:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
700:       this.pointer.down = false
701:       if (this.pointer.moved < 8) this.pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY)
702:       if (this.mode === 'habitat') this.autoRotate = true
703:     }
704:     el.addEventListener('pointerdown', down)
705:     el.addEventListener('pointermove', move)
706:     el.addEventListener('pointerup', up)
707:     el.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { this.pointer.down = false })
708:     el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
709:       e.preventDefault()

713: 
714:   pickAt(clientX, clientY) {
715:     if (this.mode !== 'habitat') return
716:     const rect = this.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect()
717:     this.ndc.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1
718:     this.ndc.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
719:     this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this.ndc, this.camera)
720:     const hits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.habitat.children, true)
721:     for (const hit of hits) {
722:       let o = hit.object
723:       while (o && !o.userData.creatureId) o = o.parent
724:       if (o?.userData.creatureId) {
725:         this.hooks.onSelect?.(o.userData.creatureId)
726:         return
727:       }
728:     }
729:     this.hooks.onBackground?.()
730:   }
731: 
732:   resize() {
733:     const w = this.container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth
734:     const h = this.container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight
735:     this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false)

740:   loop() {
741:     this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop())
742:     const dt = Math.min(0.05, this.clock.getDelta())
743:     this.time += dt
744: 
745:     if (this.mode === 'habitat') {

749:     }
750: 
751:     this.updateParticles(dt)
752: 
753:     const orbit = this.orbit
754:     if (this.autoRotate && this.mode === 'habitat') {
755:       this.orbitYaw = (this.orbitYaw ?? orbit.yaw) + dt * 0.028
756:       orbit.yaw = this.orbitYaw
757:     }
758:     const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, orbit.targetY, 0)
759:     const dist = orbit.radius
760:     const camX = Math.sin(orbit.yaw) * Math.cos(orbit.pitch) * dist
761:     const camZ = Math.cos(orbit.yaw) * Math.cos(orbit.pitch) * dist
762:     const camY = orbit.targetY + Math.sin(orbit.pitch) * dist + 0.4
763:     this.camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(camX, camY, camZ), 0.08)
764:     if (this.shakeAmt > 0.001) {
765:       this.camera.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shakeAmt
766:       this.camera.position.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shakeAmt
767:       this.shakeAmt *= 0.9
768:     }
769:     this.camera.lookAt(target)
770: 
771:     // slow toggling details
772:     if (this.isles) for (const isle of this.isles) {
773:       isle.position.y = isle.userData.baseY + Math.sin(this.time * 0.5 + isle.userData.phase) * 0.25
774:       isle.rotation.y += dt * 0.05
775:     }
776:     if (this.arena.visible && this.arenaBeams) this.arenaBeams.rotation.y += dt * 0.03

786:   updateHabitat(dt) {
787:     const list = [...this.creatures.values()]
788:     for (const entry of list) {
789:       if (!this.habitat.children.includes(entry.root)) continue
790:       entry.pause -= dt
791:       const dx = entry.target.x - entry.root.position.x
792:       const dz = entry.target.z - entry.root.position.z
793:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
794:       let moving = 0
795:       if (entry.pause <= 0) {
796:         if (dist < 0.25) {
797:           entry.pause = 2 + Math.random() * 5
798:           const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
799:           const r = 1.5 + Math.random() * 4.8
800:           entry.target.set(Math.cos(a) * r, 0, Math.sin(a) * r)
801:         } else {
802:           moving = 1
803:           const step = Math.min(dist, entry.speed * dt)
804:           entry.root.position.x += (dx / dist) * step
805:           entry.root.position.z += (dz / dist) * step
806:           const want = Math.atan2(dx, dz)
807:           let diff = want - entry.root.rotation.y
808:           while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2
809:           while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2
810:           entry.root.rotation.y += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 4)
811:         }
812:       }
813:       entry.moving += (moving - entry.moving) * Math.min(1, dt * 5)
814:       entry.root.userData.update?.(dt, entry.moving)
815:       if (this.selectedId === entry.id) {
816:         this.selectionRing.position.x = entry.root.position.x
817:         this.selectionRing.position.z = entry.root.position.z
818:         this.selectionRing.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.sin(this.time * 3) * 0.06)
819:       }
820:     }
821:     // spore drift
822:     this.driftField(this.spores, dt, 0.25)
823:     this.driftField(this.fireflies, dt, 0.6)
824:   }
825: 
826:   updateArena(dt) {
827:     if (!this.fighters) return
828:     this.fighters.player.userData.update?.(dt, 0)
829:     this.fighters.foe.userData.update?.(dt, 0)
830:     this.driftField(this.embers, dt, 0.55)
831:   }
832: 
833:   driftField(points, dt, speed) {
834:     if (!points) return
835:     const arr = points.geometry.attributes.position.array
836:     const seeds = points.userData.seeds
837:     for (let i = 0; i < seeds.length; i++) {
838:       const s = seeds[i]
839:       arr[i * 3 + 1] += s.speed * dt * speed
840:       arr[i * 3] += Math.sin(this.time * 0.5 + s.phase) * dt * 0.12
841:       arr[i * 3 + 2] += Math.cos(this.time * 0.4 + s.phase) * dt * 0.1
842:       if (arr[i * 3 + 1] > 5.8) arr[i * 3 + 1] = 0.1
843:     }
844:     points.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
845:   }
846: 
847:   updateParticles(dt) {
848:     if (!this.burstPoints) return
849:     const st = this.burstState
850:     const pos = this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.array
851:     for (let i = 0; i < st.max; i++) {
852:       if (st.life[i] <= 0) continue
853:       st.life[i] -= dt
854:       if (st.life[i] <= 0) { pos[i * 3] = 9999; continue }
855:       st.vel[i * 3 + 1] -= 6 * dt
856:       pos[i * 3] += st.vel[i * 3] * dt
857:       pos[i * 3 + 1] += st.vel[i * 3 + 1] * dt
858:       pos[i * 3 + 2] += st.vel[i * 3 + 2] * dt
859:     }
860:     this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
861:   }
862: 
863:   destroy() {
864:     cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf)
865:     this.clearCreatures()
866:     this.renderer.dispose()
867:     this.container.innerHTML = ''
868:   }
869: }

50: const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
51: export const clamp01 = v => clamp(v)
52: export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t

55: export function mulberry32(seed) {
56:   let a = seed >>> 0
57:   return function () {
58:     a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
59:     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
60:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
61:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
62:   }
63: }

67: // ─── genome creation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
68: export function randomGenome(seed, bias = {}) {
69:   const r = seed == null ? Math.random : mulberry32(seed)
70:   const genome = {}
71:   for (const gene of GENES) {
72:     const b = bias[gene.key] ?? 0.5
73:     const spread = bias[gene.key + '_spread'] ?? 0.34
74:     const center = clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * spread, 0.06, 0.96)
75:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
76:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
77:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
78:     if (bias._wild) {
79:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
80:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
81:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
82:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
83:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
84:         : [r(), r()]
85:     } else {
86:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]
87:     }
88:   }
89:   return genome
90: }

92: // Phenotype: average expression; a few genes skew dominant to create variety.
93: export function phenotype(genome) {
94:   const p = {}
95:   for (const gene of GENES) {
96:     // Older local saves predate newer appearance genes; keep them playable.
97:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome[gene.key] || []
98:     p[gene.key] = (a + b) / 2
99:   }
100:   // Derived composite values used by the mesh builder.
101:   const size = p.size
102:   p.height = 0.72 + size * 0.62 + p.legs * 0.18
103:   p.huePrimary = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueA))
104:   p.hueAccent = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueB))
105:   p.sat = Math.round(38 + p.pattern * 34 + p.muscle * 10)
106:   p.lightness = Math.round(52 - p.bone * 12 + p.eyes * 4)
107:   p.bodyColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary} ${p.sat}% ${p.lightness}%)`
108:   p.accentColor = `hsl(${p.hueAccent} ${Math.min(92, p.sat + 18)}% ${58 + p.eyes * 8}%)`
109:   p.darkColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary - 12} ${p.sat + 6}% ${Math.max(18, p.lightness - 26)}%)`
110:   p.eyeColor = `hsl(${(p.hueAccent + 38) % 360} 100% ${62 + p.brain * 10}%)`
111:   p.speciesType = ['Drake', 'Mireling', 'Skykin', 'Goliath'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))]
112:   p.skinType = ['Velvet hide', 'Scaled hide', 'Plated hide', 'Crystal hide'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.hide * 4))]
113:   p.postureName = p.posture > 0.58 ? 'Upright' : 'Grounded'
114:   const bodyPlanIndex = Math.min(BODY_PLANS.length - 1, Math.floor(p.bodyPlan * BODY_PLANS.length))
115:   p.bodyPlanKey = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].key
116:   p.bodyPlanName = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].label

139:   let sum = 0
140:   for (const gene of GENES) {
141:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome?.[gene.key] || []
142:     sum += Math.abs(a - b)

147: export function conditionOf(creature) {
148:   if (!creature) return 0
149:   const needs = creature.needs
150:   const vitality = averageNeeds(needs)
151:   const vigor = clamp01(heterozygosity(creature.genome) * 1.8) * 9
152:   const levelBonus = Math.min(6, (creature.wins || 0) * 0.8)
153:   const raw = vitality * 0.88 + vigor + levelBonus + 4
154:   return Math.round(clamp(raw, 4, 100))

260: // ─── breeding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
261: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
262:   let sum = 0
263:   for (const gene of GENES) {
264:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
265:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
266:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
267:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
268:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
269:   }
270:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
271: }
272: 
273: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
274:   const child = {}
275:   const mutations = []
276:   for (const gene of GENES) {
277:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
278:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
279:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
280:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
281:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
282:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
283:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
284:       mutations.push(gene.key)
285:     }
286:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
287:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
288:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
289:     }
290:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
291:   }
292:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
293: }
